answer.answer:
One high-severity item is still open:

- **PHMSA Annual Pipeline Safety Report** — Pipeline mileage discrepancy between GIS and PIMS systems, due **2026-03-20**.

The other high-severity finding (FERC Form 1 depreciation schedule mismatch) has already been remediated. There's also a medium (CEMS calibration records) and a low (TRI threshold methodology) still open, but those aren't high severity.
